name: SafeDrive Basic
description: Affordable basic automobile insurance for young drivers and budget-conscious customers. Covers liability and minimum collision damage. Suitable for vehicles under ten years old.

name: SafeDrive Premium Plus
description: Comprehensive automobile coverage including collision full damage protection roadside assistance rental car coverage and accident forgiveness. Recommended for new vehicles and high-value automobiles. Premium coverage for safe responsible drivers.

name: Essential Health Plan
description: Basic health insurance covering routine medical visits prescriptions emergency room access. Affordable individual coverage for healthy adults. Includes preventive care and annual checkups.

name: Family Comprehensive Health
description: Comprehensive family health plan covering parents and dependent children. Includes pediatric care maternity dental vision specialist visits. Ideal for growing families with young children. Coverage for the whole household.

name: SecureFuture Term Life
description: Affordable term life insurance providing financial protection for your dependents. Twenty-year term coverage. Designed for young families and new parents. Beneficiary protection in case of unexpected loss.

name: LegacyShield Whole Life
description: Premium whole life insurance with cash value accumulation and lifetime coverage. Builds equity over time. Designed for high income individuals and those planning legacy estate transfer. Retirement security and inheritance planning.

name: RentSafe Renters Insurance
description: Affordable renters insurance for apartment dwellers and tenants. Covers personal belongings theft fire water damage. Perfect for young professionals and students renting their first apartment.

name: HomeShield Homeowners
description: Homeowners property insurance for house and residence owners. Covers dwelling structure contents liability natural disasters fire theft water damage. Premium homeowner coverage for established property owners. Includes valuable items rider and replacement cost protection for your residence and real estate.
